title: Innokin Endura Prism T18/T22 Coils
description: Maximise the performance of your Innokin Endura T18 and T22 tanks with these premium replacement coils, crafted to deliver a perfect balance of flavour and vapour. Available in packs of five, these coils feature a 1.5ohm resistance for a classic MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping experience. They feature a 100% Japanese organic cotton wicking material to provide immaculate flavour with every draw and work best with 50/50, nic salts or high-PG e-liquids. Innokin's innovative no-spill coil swap system simplifies coil changes, allowing you to replace your coils without touching the e-liquid chamber, making maintenance clean and hassle-free. Whether you're a light, moderate, or heavy vaper, an Innokin Endura Prism coil can typically last from 1 to 3 weeks, making this 5-pack an excellent investment for 1 to 2 months of vaping. You'll know it's time for a change when vapour production decreases or your e-liquid starts to taste different. Please Note: These coils are NOT compatible with Innokin Endura T18E, T18II, T18X, T22E Kits Or T22 Pro tanks To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
